texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today it's all about castles! Forty famous castles are hiding behind a puzzle, and the pieces flip one by one. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first castle. Any idea?
Yes! It's Windsor Castle. It's the oldest and largest occupied castle in the world.
Take a good look. Which castle is this?
That's Edinburgh Castle. It stands on Castle Rock, an extinct volcano.
Easy one... or is it? Name this castle!
It's Himeji Castle. It's nicknamed the White Heron Castle.
Eyes on the screen. What castle do we have here?
Correct answer: Château de Chambord. Chambord has a famous double-spiral staircase.
You've seen this one before. Which castle?
Of course, it's the Tower of London. The Crown Jewels are kept inside.
Quick! Which castle is this?
Boom! It's the Alhambra. It was built mainly by the Nasrid rulers of Granada.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: Prague Castle. It's one of the largest castle complexes in the world.
Don't overthink it. Which castle is this?
You got it, it's Eilean Donan. It sits on a small tidal island in the Scottish Highlands.
This one is a classic. Which castle?
Spot on! It's Hohenzollern Castle. It stands on top of a mountain in southern Germany.
Last easy one! Which castle is this?
The answer is Castel Sant'Angelo. It was first built as a tomb for Emperor Hadrian.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which castle is this?
Yes! It's Malbork Castle. It's the largest castle in the world by land area.
Look closely at the details. Which castle?
That's Bodiam Castle. This 14th-century castle is surrounded by a wide moat.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this castle!
It's Conwy Castle. It was built for King Edward the First in the 1280s.
This one fools a lot of people. Which castle is it?
Correct answer: Warwick Castle. It began as a wooden fort built by William the Conqueror in 1068.
Can you get this one right? Which castle?
Of course, it's Peleș Castle. It was one of the first castles in Europe with electricity.
Think carefully. What castle is this?
Boom! It's Château de Chenonceau. It's built across the River Cher.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: Pena Palace. It sits on a hilltop above Sintra, in Portugal.
Got it already? Which castle is this?
You got it, it's Osaka Castle. Its main tower was rebuilt in concrete in 1931.
Keep that streak going! Which castle?
Spot on! It's Kronborg. Shakespeare set Hamlet here, under the name Elsinore.
Last medium question! Which castle is this?
The answer is Lichtenstein Castle. It sits on a cliff edge in the Swabian Alps.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which castle is this?
Yes! It's the Alcázar of Segovia. Its shape is said to look like the bow of a ship.
Not so easy now. Which castle?
That's Bled Castle. It's the oldest castle in Slovenia, first mentioned in 1011.
Here's one for the experts. Name this castle!
It's Trakai Island Castle. It stands on an island in Lake Galvė, in Lithuania.
Take your time... but not too much. Which castle?
Correct answer: Spiš Castle. It's one of the largest castle sites in Central Europe.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which castle is it?
Of course, it's Matsumoto Castle. Its black walls earned it the nickname Crow Castle.
Big brain time! What castle is this?
Boom! It's Burg Eltz. The same family has owned it for over 800 years.
Lock in your answer! Which castle?
Here it is: Orava Castle. It was a filming location for the 1922 film Nosferatu.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's Château de Pierrefonds. It was rebuilt by the architect Viollet-le-Duc in the 1800s.
Are you still with me? Which castle is this?
Spot on! It's Vianden Castle. This hilltop castle is the most famous in Luxembourg.
Last hard one! Which castle?
The answer is Caernarfon Castle. Its walls were inspired by the walls of Constantinople.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which castle is this?
Yes! It's Krak des Chevaliers. It's one of the best-preserved Crusader castles in the world.
Seriously tough now. Name this castle!
That's Corvin Castle. It's in Romania, and is also known as Hunyad Castle.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which castle?
It's Bojnice Castle. It hosts an International Festival of Ghosts every spring.
Deep cut! Which castle is this?
Correct answer: Predjama Castle. It's built inside the mouth of a cave.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's Mir Castle. It's a UNESCO World Heritage site in Belarus.
No hints this time. Which castle?
Boom! It's Castel del Monte. Its floor plan is a perfect octagon.
Almost there! Which castle is this?
Here it is: Haut-Kœnigsbourg. It overlooks the Alsace plain in eastern France.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which castle?
You got it, it's Kumamoto Castle. It was badly damaged by an earthquake in 2016.
Second to last! Name this castle!
Spot on! It's Mehrangarh Fort. It towers about 120 metres above the city of Jodhpur.
Final question! Make it count. Which castle is this?
The answer is Rumeli Hisarı. It was built in just four months, in 1452.
That's the end of our castle tour! How many did you recognise? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
